name: Minato Shin'ichirou
source:
Minato is a mathematics teacher at the school. He is very strict, and can strike fear into his students with his harsh glare. He is also a pervert who uses his dominating personality to make sexual advances on students: including Sora and Sunao. 

[spoiler]The detective that Sora admired as a child. He is like an older brother to Sora and his friends.

He is a cheerful, outgoing person who is always joking around, but once he makes a decision, he doesn't change it.  However, he is also a handsome guy.

For several years now, he has been infiltrating the school as a math teacher in pursuit of Aizawa.[/spoiler]

[Translated from [url=http://amusecraft.com/platinumlabel/platinum_me/project/sukisyo3.html]official website[/url]]
